import csv
import io

from app.models import Reserva
from tests.conftest import otp_for

RESERVA = {"sala": "Atlas", "fecha": "2026-10-05T10:00", "duracion_min": 60}


def basic_auth_headers(username: str, password: str) -> dict:
    return {"X-OTP": otp_for(username)}


def test_export_sin_reservas_devuelve_solo_cabecera(client):
    r = client.get("/export", auth=("alice", "alice-pass"), headers={"X-OTP": otp_for("alice")})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.headers["content-type"].startswith("text/csv")
    filas = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(r.text)))
    assert filas == [list(Reserva.model_fields)]


def test_export_con_reservas(client, auth):
    client.post("/reservas", json=RESERVA, headers=auth)
    r = client.get("/export", auth=("alice", "alice-pass"), headers={"X-OTP": otp_for("alice")})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    filas = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(r.text)))
    columnas = list(Reserva.model_fields)
    assert filas[0] == columnas
    assert len(filas) == 2
    fila = dict(zip(columnas, filas[1]))
    assert fila["sala"] == "Atlas"
    assert fila["usuario"] == "alice"


def test_export_sin_credenciales(client):
    assert client.get("/export").status_code == 401


def test_export_con_password_incorrecta(client):
    r = client.get("/export", auth=("alice", "mal"), headers={"X-OTP": otp_for("alice")})
    assert r.status_code == 401
